## Hypothesis

The edge we are trying to capture is the ability to veto trades based on the direction of the trend, as indicated by the `crypto.lib.market_structure.classify_trend` function. This function uses a 5-minute same-day trend classification to determine the direction of the trend. By incorporating this veto into the entry path, we can potentially improve the overall performance of the strategy by removing wrong-way trades.

## Mechanism

The mechanism for this candidate involves wiring the `crypto.lib.market_structure.classify_trend` function into the entry path and blocking P-in-uptrend and C-in-downtrend trades. This means that if the trend is classified as uptrend, the strategy will not enter a put trade, and if the trend is classified as downtrend, the strategy will not enter a call trade. The veto will be applied at the filter level, and the guard will be implemented in the `backtest/tests/test_structure_veto.py` test.
